name: tailscale
description: Tailscale connector: Tailscale 1.104.7 (tailscale/tailscale by digest), a tailnet node in userspace networking (no tun, no capability). It forwards tailnet TCP 443 to one linked service as raw TCP with a PROXY v2 header. Set TS_AUTHKEY and TS_TARGET ([NAME@]ADDRESS:PORT; NAME is its tailnet name, the service's own by default) with service_secret_set, then instance_start. Its state is on its data volume, so it logs in once. No port of its own; it reaches only what it is linked to.
